task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

plans.R1:
Based on the image and the listed items, here's a plan to set up a comfortable space for someone with the flu:

[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the mug with water from the tap. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the tomato from the fridge. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the tomato. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the sliced tomato on a plate. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up a spoon from the drawer. (r1_s6)

[15-20 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug of water, sliced tomato, and spoon to another robot for delivery to the resting area. (r1_s7)

This plan ensures the person has water and a light snack, which are essential for recovery.
